mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC

WITH RECURSIVE authorized_menu ( id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, permission, icon, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time, deleted ) AS ( SELECT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.permission, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.deleted FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role admin_ur INNER JOIN sys_role admin_r ON admin_ur.role_id = admin_r.id AND admin_r.status = 1 AND admin_r.deleted = 0 WHERE admin_ur.user_id = #{userId} AND admin_r.role_code = 'ADMIN' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND rm.menu_id = m.id ) ) UNION SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.menu_name, parent.menu_type, parent.path, parent.permission, parent.icon, parent.sort_order, parent.status, parent.create_time, parent.update_time, parent.deleted FROM sys_menu parent INNER JOIN authorized_menu child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.status = 1 AND parent.deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, permission, icon, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM authorized_menu ORDER BY sort_order ASC
